About the Meeting

Meeting Goals

Review progress, accomplishments, and lessons learned
Strengthen team building, communication, and relationships across PanKbase
Strengthen scientific and operational integration across PanKbase
Identify emerging scientific and data science opportunities
Align on priorities for the coming year
Translate priorities into concrete actions, responsibilities, and milestones
Michigan League

Venue Maps & Parking

All meeting sessions take place at the Michigan League, 911 N University Ave, Ann Arbor, MI 48109. Use the tabs below for walking routes from the conference hotels, nearby parking, and building floor plans. Starred rooms are where sessions take place.

🚶 From Graduate by Hilton
About 7 min · 0.3 mi. Head east on E Huron St past N State and N Thayer, cut south to E Washington St, then follow the Ingalls Mall green south to the Michigan League.
🚶 From The Vanguard
About 8 min · 0.3 mi. Walk south on Glen Ave to E Huron St, take the diagonal path across the green to Fletcher St, then head south on Fletcher to the Michigan League.
🌧 November Weather
Mid-November in Ann Arbor is often cold and damp. Bring a warm coat and umbrella; rideshares are an easy alternative.

Once inside, breakfast and morning sessions are in the Vandenberg Room on the second floor. See the floor plan tabs for room locations.

🅿 Lot N4
On S. Thayer St between E. Liberty and E. Washington. Closest structure to Michigan League — approximately a 3-minute walk. Visitor pay stations available.
🅿 Lot N13
On Fletcher St near E. Washington. Approximately a 5-minute walk to Michigan League. Additional visitor parking option.
🚶 Walking from Hotels
Both conference hotels are a 7–8 minute walk. See the Getting to the Michigan League tab for routes.

Parking on campus is limited. Visit pts.umich.edu for current availability and rates. Arrive early on meeting days.

Transportation

Getting to Ann Arbor

The closest major airport is Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW), approximately 45 minutes from Ann Arbor by car. Several ground transportation options are available from both terminals.

Rideshare
Uber & Lyft
McNamara Terminal: Level 4 of the McNamara Parking Garage — cross the skybridge from the terminal.

Evans Terminal: Level 1 of the Evans Parking Garage — cross the skybridge.

Collect baggage, follow Ground Transportation/Skybridge signs, and check your app for the exact pickup bay.
Taxi & Luxury Sedan
Metro Cars / Metro Cab
Officially serviced by Metro Cars and Metro Cab. Both dispatch from the Ground Transportation Center (Level 4 at McNamara; upper Level 4 at Evans).

Metro Cab: (734) 997-6500
Metro Cars: (800) 456-1701

On-site kiosks also available at both terminals.
Coach Bus — Recommended
Michigan Flyer / AirRide
Michigan Flyer offers direct nonstop motorcoach service between DTW and downtown Ann Arbor. Affordable and convenient — a great option for solo travelers. Boards from the Ground Transportation Centers at both terminals.
Express Bus
Detroit Air Xpress (DAX)
DAX provides nonstop express bus service to downtown Detroit. Pick up at Evans Terminal (Stalls 1–2) or McNamara Terminal (Departures Level, near Door 1).
Public Transit
SMART Bus
SMART Bus routes including FAST Michigan Route 261 and Route 125 serve both terminal Ground Transportation Centers, connecting DTW to Detroit and nearby communities.
Rental Car
On-Site Rental Shuttles
Off-site rental car courtesy shuttles pick up directly from the Ground Transportation Centers at both terminals. All major rental car companies are represented. A free inter-terminal shuttle also runs every 10 minutes between McNamara and Evans if needed.
